data.name: San Diego Bike Rentals
data.description:
Explore San Diego in a unique way - by Bike! From our store location, guests will be able to see all of the vibrant scenes that San Diego has to offer - from theaters to parks to art galleries to symphony halls to museums. Ride through Balboa Park and visit the Bea Evenson Fountain, San Diego Zoo, Japanese Friendship Garden, San Diego Air & Space Museum and more! Then, bike through the historic infamous Gaslamp Quarter towards the Embarcadero, which has some of the best views of San Diego. You’ll be able to see all of the amazing downtown gems, including the USS Midway, Embarcadero Marina Park, Billionaire Row, Maritime Museum, Bob Hope Memorial, Tuna Pier, and Seaport Village!


We offer bikes for everyone, including eBikes, Kids Bikes and Tandems. Additionally, we have tag-a-long and toddler trailers available for families.

Please be aware of our **Store Hours**, as bikes must be returned by closing time:
November - March: 9AM - 5PM
April - October: 9AM - 7PM
data.cancellation_notes:
Bike Rental Cancellation Policy

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your rental.

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the rental, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid that will never expire!

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
data.booking_notes:
PICK UP LOCATION : Please look closely at the location that you picked in the booking.

330 K Street
San Diego, CA 92101

Please be aware of our Store Hours, as bikes must be returned by closing time:
November-March: 9AM - 5PM
April - October: 9AM - 7PM

Please bring along a valid form of identification and a credit card with you, as these will be needed for security upon check-in for your rentals. Your outfit should be seasonally suitable; we also suggest that you dress in something comfy, not too loose, and closed-toe shoes. Don't forget a proper ID and your camera!

For any questions, please feel free to reach our team at 212-749-4444. We'll see you soon!

Know Before You Go:

All children must be one year or older to be on any bike/bike attachments. It is for the child's own safety and is the law.

Any riders under 18 years of age must have an adult present to check in and sign the waiver form in behalf of them. We require a valid identity card upon check in.

For all our riders' safety, we are not able to accommodate any riders who are 300 pounds and over as this exceeds the weight limit the manufacturer has advised for the bike's build. 

We apologize for the inconvenience, but we do prioritize your safety during the ride.

If anything from the list above concerns you or any members of your party, please feel free to reach out to our team by responding to this email. We will get back to you as soon as we can!

--------------------
#SELF GUIDED TOUR APP:
Unlimited Biking offers a self guided bike tour app for guests to download and use during their ride. Riders can choose the Best of San Diego Bike Tour Route. This is a great tool for riders who want to ride at their own pace! This self-guided audio tool showcases the best historical/cultural sites, movie references, picture-worthy spots, and even accessible restrooms throughout your route! Click [here]([https://onelink.to/kjhg6u) to download onto your mobile app!
